title: Northbeam TechWorks Desk Table: Which Surcharge Percent an Attendance Carries
content:
The surcharge percent carried by an attendance on a Northbeam TechWorks Installation and Repair job turns on the day read and on the window the slot booked for that attendance stood in.

## The rule

The surcharge percent is the service's weekend surcharge percent where that day falls on a Saturday or a Sunday and the slot booked for the attendance stood in a window other than the evening; it is the service's after-hours surcharge percent where that day falls from Monday to Friday and the slot booked for the attendance stood in the evening. The weekend percent and the after-hours percent are never both applied to the same hour, so exactly one of them is read for an attendance, and where neither situation holds no surcharge at all is read.

## The four combinations of day and window

| The day read | The window the slot stood in | Percent read |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Saturday or Sunday | a window other than the evening | the service's weekend surcharge percent |
| Saturday or Sunday | the evening | no surcharge at all |
| Monday to Friday | the evening | the service's after-hours surcharge percent |
| Monday to Friday | a window other than the evening | no surcharge at all |

The two named situations are mutually exclusive, so exactly one percent — or none — is read for an attendance, and the two percentages are never both applied to the same hour. The service's own weekend and after-hours percentages are carried per TechWorks service alongside its ordinary service hours.

## Illustrations on hypothetical attendances

**A Saturday morning attendance.** The day read falls on a Saturday and the window is the morning, which is a window other than the evening, so the percent read is the weekend surcharge percent of the TechWorks service the job is handled under.

**A Thursday evening attendance.** The day read falls from Monday to Friday and the slot stood in the evening, so the percent read is that service's after-hours surcharge percent.

**A Sunday evening attendance.** The day falls at the weekend but the window is the evening, so neither situation holds and no surcharge at all is read.

**A Tuesday morning attendance.** The day falls from Monday to Friday but the window is not the evening, so again no surcharge at all is read.
